同时在途准备、翻译与修补的页数（1–16，默认 4）。数值越大吞吐越高，但更吃显: Pages prepared, translated, and retouched at the same time (1–16, default 4). Higher values improve throughput but use more VRAM and RAM; 2–4 is recommended on 8 GB GPUs.
PDF 页图的分辨率（96–400，默认 200）。越高越清晰，也越慢、越占内存: Resolution of rendered PDF pages (96–400, default 200). Higher is sharper but slower and uses more memory; image inputs are unaffected.
新排版使用的基准字号（8–96，默认 16）。精修页可以逐块调整，这里只改变之后: Base font size for new typesetting (8–96, default 16). Individual blocks can still be adjusted in the editor; this only affects pages generated afterwards.
启用「AI 字体判别」时，每块文本重复判定的次数（1–5，默认 3）。次数越多越: How many times each text block is probed when AI font matching is enabled (1–5, default 3). More samples are more stable but consume more tokens.
并行与字号只影响之后生成的页面；修改 PDF DPI 会让断点续传重新渲染 PD: Parallelism and font size only affect pages generated afterwards. Changing PDF DPI makes resume re-render PDFs.
留空使用内置默认路径；更换文件后下一次任务会重新加载模型。: Leave empty to use the built-in default path. Replacing a file reloads the model on the next task.
只恢复本页字段，点击「保存配置」后才会写入。: Only resets fields on this page; click Save settings to write them.
